notes.title: Patch 2.1
notes.notes:
Bug fix: the achievement "Intruder" is now achievable.

Improved one of the puzzles according to player feedback,

notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.notes:
Version 2.0 is a major update to the game.

The number of puzzles has been significantly increased, and a few new illustrations have been added based on player feedback. Several bugs have been fixed, particularly those related to music and sound effects.
